# Text

From [the component index](../components.md). A prop with `?` is optional, and `= x` is its default. An indented line is the shape of a value the prop takes. In the examples, `children`, `transactions`, the icons and the handlers stand for the screen's own content, data and state.

## Text

```tsx
import { Text } from "@tuja/ui/components/text";
```

All body copy, labels and captions; choose the size with `look` and the colour with `tone`.

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode` — Text content to render.
- `as?: "p" | "span" | "div" = "p"` — Semantic element to render, decoupled from the visual look.
- `look?: "body" | "bodySmall" | "label" | "caption" | "overline" = "body"` — Type role that sets the font size, line height, weight and tracking together.
- `tone?: "default" | "muted" | "accent" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info" = "default"` — Foreground colour role, resolved per theme.
- `weight?: "regular" | "medium" | "semibold" | "bold"` — Overrides the weight that `look` sets.
- `transform?: "uppercase" | "lowercase" | "capitalize"` — Case transform, decoupled from `look` — so an uppercase "eyebrow" label can sit at any size (`caption`, `bodySmall`, …) rather than only through the `overline` role.
- `align?: "start" | "center" | "end"` — Text alignment (logical `start` / `center` / `end`).
- `wrap?: "balance" | "pretty" | "nowrap"` — How lines break. `"pretty"` avoids stranding one word on the last line — the choice for body copy, and the default of a paragraph.
- `measure?: "prose" | "none" = "prose"` — The width cap of a paragraph.
- `numeric?: boolean` — Renders figures at a fixed width so numbers line up in a column and a ticking value doesn't jitter.
- `verbatim?: boolean` — Shows the text as a person or an agent wrote it: "(1)", "2x3" and "->" stay as typed, where Haffer would draw "①", "2×3" and "→".
- `lines?: number` — Shows at most this many lines and ends the last one with "…".
- `id?: string` — Id applied to the rendered element, so another node can point `aria-labelledby` / `aria-describedby` here.
- `ref?: Ref<HTMLElement>` — Ref to the rendered element (`<p>`, `<span>`, or `<div>`).

Example:

```tsx
function TextExample() {
  return (
    <Text as="p" look="bodySmall" tone="muted">
      What came in overnight, and what needs you.
    </Text>
  );
}
```

## Heading

```tsx
import { Heading } from "@tuja/ui/components/heading";
```

A heading: `level` sets the rank, `look` the size.

Props (also `css`):

- `children: ReactNode` — Heading content to render.
- `level?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 = 2` — Semantic heading rank, driving the rendered `<h1>`–`<h6>` element.
- `look?: "display" | "h1" | "h2" | "h3" | "h4"` — Type role, decoupled from `level` so rank and size can differ.
- `weight?: "regular" | "medium" | "semibold" | "bold" | "extrabold" | "black"` — Overrides the weight `look` sets, extending `Text`'s weight vocabulary with `extrabold`/`black` for the display range.
- `align?: "start" | "center" | "end"` — Text alignment (logical `start` / `center` / `end`).
- `wrap?: "balance" | "pretty" | "nowrap"` — How lines break, via CSS `text-wrap`.
- `id?: string` — Id applied to the rendered heading, so a region can name itself with `aria-labelledby` pointing here.
- `ref?: Ref<HTMLHeadingElement>` — Ref to the rendered heading element.

Example:

```tsx
function HeadingExample() {
  return (
    <Heading level={2} look="h4">
      Needs you
    </Heading>
  );
}
```

## CodeBlock

```tsx
import { CodeBlock } from "@tuja/ui/components/code-block";
```

A block of code drawn as coloured runs.

Props (also `css`):

- `label: string` — The accessible name of the block, such as "Code".
- `contentCss?: StyleProp` — StyleX styles merged last, on the scroller inside the block.
- `source?: readonly CodeToken[]` — The runs to draw, in source order, for a snippet that never changes.
- `parts?: readonly CodePart[]` — The parts to draw.
  - `CodePart { id: string; lead: string; tokens: readonly CodeToken[] }`
